content.short: Earn Crypto Tokens & NFTs while contributing Open Source Projects.
content.description: PRToken is a platform that provides an opportunity for Github Repository owner to incentivise their contributors in any form of token, can be token of Appreciation (Incentives) or Recognition (NFT). Developers may not just get rewarded for PR (Pull Request) contributions but extend the possibility to get rewarded with NFT for each PR where it could also be used for to improve their individual’s portfolio/resume and for their career opportunities. In addition of that, we provide the ability to mint for every approved PR.
content.meta: Find out about PRToken (PRTOKEN) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
